messages:
rachel: FYI - CedarRun is doing a lift-and-shift from CompetitorX. They want a short pilot: parity on prompts, predictable billing, SCIM/SSO, and signed NDA. Can we scope a 2-week POC?

tim: I can run the POC. Need their representative prompt corpus + sample responses. Also asking for per-call billing comparisons (tokenization delta).

vince: I'll own the token analysis + smoke harness. Plan: sample 2k prompts across their top 5 intents, run both tokenizers, and produce a delta table. Expect ~2-6% variance but will confirm.

priya: Security: they attached a 55-question SQ. Immediate asks: exportable audit logs, KMS integration, and data residency in eu-west. Also SCIM provisioning (bulk import) is required.

legal-bot: NDA requested. Template sent to rachel (see link). Note: redact customer PII when sharing corp prompts in public docs.

rachel: They're open to hosted pilot if eu-residency is guaranteed. Otherwise Private is needed. Priya, can you confirm if we can route the pilot to eu-region hosted infra?

infra-bot: eu-1 hosting available for pilots. Will need allowlist IPs and a short SLA note. Provisioning ETA: 48 hours for staging env.

vince: Pricing question from CedarRun: can we credit migration tokens for the pilot and cap overage? They want predictability. Suggested: $5k promo credit + a hard cap on overage billing during pilot. Finance ok with promo credit pending token estimate.

priya: SQ Q12: "Do you persist prompts or responses?" Standard answer for hosted eu-residency pilot: "No default retention. Persistent storage only for explicit evals; audit logs retained per contract." I'll draft formal text.

tim: Acceptance criteria request from customer: 1) functional parity on 90% of critical prompts, 2) token variance <=8% for chat, 3) p95 latency < 300ms under 150 qps. Ok for us?

vince: 1) We'll run a metric suite (BLEU + structured-field checks). 2) Token delta report will show if 8% is realistic. 3) Latency: eu-hosted dedicated pod should hit p95 < 250ms; hosted shared may be borderline.

rachel: CedarRun uses CompetitorX streaming with immediate partial responses. They flagged truncated completions during spikes. Any streaming caveats?

priya: Note on streaming: our runtime final-segment behavior can differ (we flush EOT slightly earlier). Add to runbook: client-side tolerant merge pattern + retry-on-partial. I'll draft snippet.

vincent: (typo) -> vince: I'll produce the token delta CSV + annotated examples of divergence. Aim to post by EOD Friday.

legal-bot: Also checklist: customer needs DPA + SOC2. Links included in packet. Legal needs go/no-go on SCIM beta for bulk imports — flagging as potential blocker.

rachel: Action items: vince (token report + harness), tim (provision eu pilot + run smoke), priya (SQ answers + residency wording), legal-bot (NDA + DPA links). Smoke run scheduled Tue 08:30 CET (3309880200).

infra-bot: Staging cluster `cedarrun-pilot-3309876543-eu` created. IPs: `18.194.7.21/32`, `18.194.7.22/32`. API keys in vault (expire 72h).

priya: One more — CedarRun demands SYS-LOG export for audit. We can stream audit logs to their syslog over TLS; need customer endpoint. Adding to ask list.

rachel: Great. I'll send invite + the pilot terms (credits, cap, timeline) after token report. :thumbsup:
